editorial.name: Aceternity UI Svelte
editorial.descriptionZh: 有人把 Aceternity UI 的动效组件搬到 Svelte，页面自己声明是非官方版本、与原作者无关。
editorial.takeawayZh: 把 Aceternity 那批动效组件按 Svelte 版复制走
editorial.noteZh: 整页深色底。左边 h1 写 Make your Svelte app look 10x modern，正文 Copy paste the most trending components and use them in your websites without having to worry about styling and animations.，下面一行橙色小字自己交代 This is an unofficial port of Aceternity UI for Svelte, and is not affiliated with @mannupaaji.；再往下是 Browse Components 按钮和三枚标签 Svelte / TailwindCSS / Svelte Motion。右边第一张就是可以悬停试的文本揭示卡，卡上写 Sometimes, you just need to see it. This is a text reveal card. Hover over the card to reveal the hidden text.；它下面并排两张卡，一张配图写 Amazing Tailwindcss Grid Layout Examples 带 14th February, 2024 与 Read More，另一张写 Svelte — The power of full-stack to the frontend.。顶栏只有 Aceternity UI Svelte 标志和 Components 一项，外加 X（原 Twitter）入口与 Search Components ⌘K，右上角另有一排头像。

reasons.statement: 交付物是可复制粘贴的 Svelte 动效组件，站点自称 unofficial port，页面只有 Components 一段，没有原站那样的 Blocks 与 Templates，故归 general-ui-components 而不是 page-blocks-embeddable-controls。
正文标签写明基于 Svelte、TailwindCSS 与 Svelte Motion，technologies 据此收 svelte、tailwind、motion；页面上没有任何许可证信息，licenses 记 unknown。
